name: Plain
one_liner: Customer support platform for managing customer threads, built on a GraphQL API.
auth_notes: Bearer API key sent in the Authorization header, created per machine user with fine-grained permissions. OAuth is used for user-level access to the API and is the only option for the MCP server.
access_notes: Machine user and API key are created in Plain Settings under Machine users & agents, with permissions selected per key. Pages do not state plan requirements or cost.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve machine user API key with a documented GraphQL endpoint and Bearer auth. Plan requirements and cost are not stated on the pages.

identity.quote: Plain itself is built on this same GraphQL API.

auth.quote: A machine user can have several API keys, so you can rotate them without downtime.

access.quote: In Settings, open Machine Users and create a machine user with read-only permissions.

api_surface.quote: For TypeScript, the GraphQL SDK gives you a fully typed client for these operations.

mcp.quote: The Plain Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at https://mcp.plain.com/mcp supports OAuth only.

buildability.quote: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN where the token is your API key.

needs_human_reason: Pages do not state plan requirements or pricing for API or machine user access; confirm on Plain pricing or with sales.
